safetyRule: Teta Nahla operates the hot domed saj oven; player prepares dough, olive oil, and zaatar topping.

steps.prompt: Roll fresh flatbread dough on the wooden board
Brush golden Byblos olive oil across the dough
Sprinkle wild mountain za'atar, sumac, and toasted sesame
Hand to Teta Nahla to bake on the warm domed saj
